method: ABBA listed in final_order. Arithmetic mean of two run means; percentile ranges retain both runs, nearest rank. Exclude first 1s per phase, screenshot request and next 2 frames; attack requires 200 simultaneous montages. GT/render/RHI overlap and are not summed. 30Hz candidate is not enabled by default.

verification.scope: Real offscreen viewport/RHI and actual constructed retarget bodies; simplified camera/light scene; no remote clients. GPU counters may be delayed. Captures affect frame timing.

process.memoryScope: Entire editor game process including startup, sampled every 500ms; not incremental crowd memory.
